scenarios.name: rainfed
scenarios.requires: rainfall and soil water only; no scheduled irrigation

scenarios.name: supplemental_irrigation
scenarios.requires: confirmed access to limited irrigation water

yield_selection_note: Run DSSAT for each feasible scenario first. Choose among simulated results only after applying water feasibility, cost, and material benefit rules; do not select irrigation solely because it has the highest simulated yield.
